## See how we’ve reimagined Authorize.net

### New features, built for speed

Get paid faster with customizable dashboards, smart AI support, and built-in fraud prevention—all
powered by Visa’s payments ecosystem.

### Take, request, and find payments

Get set up fast with a seamless, intuitive payment experience.

### Not sure about something? Ask Anet

Get the answers you need, fast, with our new AI support tool, Ask Anet.

### Workspaces that stay connected

Stay connected across tools, teams, and transactions—backed by Visa.

### Tools to stop fraud fast

Protect every payment with built-in, real-time fraud detection.

[Demo for businesses][36]

[Demo for partners][37]

## Make payments a growth engine for your business

#### Online payments

Offer flexible online payments with credit cards, debit cards, eChecks, and major digital wallets
like Apple Pay, Google Pay, and PayPal for secure, convenient checkout.

[ [Learn more about online payments] ][38]

#### Smartphone payments

Accept secure mobile payments with smartphones, supporting QR codes, digital wallets, and fast
tap‑to‑pay options for easy checkout.

[ [Learn more about mobile payments] ][39]

#### In person with a card reader

Use Virtual Point of Sale to connect a card reader to your computer, sign in, and accept reliable
in‑person payments quickly and securely.

[ [Learn more about Virtual Point of Sale] ][40]

#### Over the phone

Process phone orders securely by entering customer details in the Virtual Terminal, allowing quick
manual payments through any web browser.

#### eCheck

Enable simple eCheck payments for recurring billing, invoices, and contactless transactions,
offering a low‑cost, dependable digital alternative.

#### Simple Checkout

Add Buy Now or Donate buttons to your site for fast checkout, ideal for nonprofits and merchants
selling single items or low‑volume products.

[ [Learn more about Simple Checkout] ][41]

## Frequently asked questions

### What is PayPal Braintree?

PayPal Braintree is a global payment processing solution that delivers end-to-end checkout
experiences for businesses, offering single-touch payments, mobile SDKs, and global currency
acceptance for seamless transactions.

### What are the accepted PayPal Braintree payment methods?

PayPal Braintree supports [PayPal][23] payments, [Venmo][24] (in the US), credit and debit cards,
popular digital wallets like Apple Pay and Google Pay, as well as local payment methods. [Learn more
about payment methods][25].

### Where can I log in to my Braintree account?

Using your established Braintree login username and password, you can [access your Braintree Control
Panel here][26]. If you have corporate domain credentials, you can [use single sign on to log
in][27].

### Is PayPal Braintree PCI compliant?

PayPal Braintree is a validated Level 1 PCI DSS compliant service provider and offers a secure
checkout experience with ready-built payment interfaces that meet SAQ-A PCI compliance validation
requirements. [Learn more about PCI compliance][28].

### What are the capabilities of the PayPal Braintree Sandbox?

Our [sandbox][29] lets you test and get a feel for the PayPal Braintree experience before you apply.
* Try our payment processing platform with no obligation to apply for a PayPal Braintree account
* Explore the control panel, reporting tools, and features
* Run sample test transactions, play with subscriptions, and fully test the API

### For Merchants

disconnected systems.

* Virtual terminals, payment links, and customer-on-file
* Reporting and dispute/chargeback workflows

### For ISVs & SaaS Platforms

Integrate embedded payments, monetize transactions, and fully brand the experience-without building
payments infrastructure.

## Plenty of Features to Meet your Business Needs

Whether you are a Business looking for payment processing, an ISV looking to become a Fintech, or an
Agent looking to become a Fintech, GETTRX One has features that will take your business to the next
level.

### Payment Processing & Merchant Services
* Card + ACH processing with common transaction flows (auth/capture/sale/void/refund)
* Tools for accepting payments: virtual terminal, payment links, customer-on-file
* Operational visibility: deposits, settlements, statements, and reporting

## Make payments a growth engine for your business

#### Online payments

Offer flexible online payments with credit cards, debit cards, eChecks, and major digital wallets
like Apple Pay, Google Pay, and PayPal for secure, convenient checkout.

[ [Learn more about online payments] ][38]

#### Smartphone payments

Accept secure mobile payments with smartphones, supporting QR codes, digital wallets, and fast
tap‑to‑pay options for easy checkout.

[ [Learn more about mobile payments] ][39]

#### In person with a card reader

Use Virtual Point of Sale to connect a card reader to your computer, sign in, and accept reliable
in‑person payments quickly and securely.

[ [Learn more about Virtual Point of Sale] ][40]

#### Over the phone

Process phone orders securely by entering customer details in the Virtual Terminal, allowing quick
manual payments through any web browser.

#### eCheck

Enable simple eCheck payments for recurring billing, invoices, and contactless transactions,
offering a low‑cost, dependable digital alternative.

#### Simple Checkout

Add Buy Now or Donate buttons to your site for fast checkout, ideal for nonprofits and merchants
selling single items or low‑volume products.

[ [Learn more about Simple Checkout] ][41]

## Frequently asked questions

### What is PayPal Braintree?

PayPal Braintree is a global payment processing solution that delivers end-to-end checkout
experiences for businesses, offering single-touch payments, mobile SDKs, and global currency
acceptance for seamless transactions.

### What are the accepted PayPal Braintree payment methods?

PayPal Braintree supports [PayPal][23] payments, [Venmo][24] (in the US), credit and debit cards,

## Financial infrastructure for platforms, fintechs, and banks building the future of money.

### Build financial products your customers love while transforming your financial operations into a
### competitive advantage. Deploy enterprise-grade stablecoin infrastructure with Mural Pay—launch
### accounts, wallets, and payments in weeks.

* ### **Store**
  
  **Keep funds secure in multiple currencies, including stablecoins, all in one place. Mural Pay
  gives you full control over your balances with instant access whenever you need to move money.**

  **Move money across borders to anyone, anywhere, in their preferred currency. Mural Pay
  streamlines every transfer with real-time tracking and fast settlement, so your recipients get
  paid without the wait.**

  **Accept payments from anywhere in the world with dedicated accounts. Mural Pay handles routing
  and FX complexity so funds land in your account ready to use. Seamlessly accept stablecoins now.**
* ### **Convert**
  
  **Swap between currencies at market-leading rates with full transparency. Mural Pay shows you
  exactly what you're getting before you confirm, without hidden fees.**
* ### **Earn**
  
  **Put idle balances to work. Mural Pay lets you generate yield on stored funds, turning dormant
  cash into passive income.**
* ### **Comply**
  
  **Enable global financial workflows without having to acquire licensing or build your own
  compliance program. Mural Pay automates compliance checks and regulatory reporting so you can
  focus on growing your business.**

# Success Stories

"In today’s connected world, business transactions need to be as seamless and integrated as
possible. The PayMate platform provides added convenience for our B2B customers to automate their
business payments, providing a seamless experience. As the Indian market transitions into a digital
economy, solutions such as these will play a key role in helping businesses embrace transition and
embrace the world of digital commerce"

Chavi Jafa Vice President, Head of Business Solutions, Asia Pacific

“In addition to our vendor payments, we have now started making GST payment via PayMate’s automated
system and API-based GST payment feature which comes with Bank issued VISA commercial card
enablement. It has been a seamless experience for our team to execute pan-India GST transactions in
a hassle-free and timely manner.”

Pawan Agrawal Ex-CFO, Marico Limited

"The PayMate platform has helped us manage our vendor payment. Through the platform’s approval
workflow which involves a maker-checker concept, it has become easier for us to check & approve
payments. Using the platform has helped us to manage our liquidity whenever there is a business
opportunity."

Mitesh V. Shah GM Finance

"We at FREIGHT TIGER, build a technology platform for the logistics industry. Through PayMate, we
have managed to automate a lot of our internal payments and transactions to a great extent. We like
working with the PayMate team. They have been super helpful and responsive to our requests."

Swapnil Shah CEO

“We have been using the PayMate platform since 2013 and it helped us to digitize and automate our
payment collections from our corporate customers. The platform enabled us to reduce our efforts to a
great extent as we can send payment links to all our customers in bulk instead of doing it one at a
time. The team has also been accessible and supportive at all times to accommodate custom changes on
the platform.”

Mr. Partha Sarathi IBM Key Account Manager

“A core element of Citi's strategy is providing our customers with innovative and efficient global
payment options - and corporate clients are progressively exploring payment facilitator/PSP models
to streamline their supplier payments within the Business-to-Business (B2B) domain. The payment
facilitator model enables corporates to optimize their working capital benefits and strengthen
supplier relationships. Citi is at the forefront of working with payment facilitators to open up new
payment flows to Commercial Cards.”

Vivek Vaidyanathan Treasury & Trade Solutions Head Citi UAE

"We are pleased to partner with PayMate which has enabled us with their B2B payments solution
through which all our suppliers who don’t have the provisions to accept card payments can be paid
directly into their bank accounts. Their solution helps us use credit, manage our cash flow better
and ensure complete automation to avoid time-consuming processes.”

Suchit Sehgal Managing Director Logistic Plus

# Pay by credit card.
# Vendors get paid the way they want.

Plastiq gives you the flexibility to pay by credit card — even when your vendors don’t accept them.
Plastiq sends your payments to your vendor as a domestic or international wire,  same-day ACH
transfer, or overnight check — all in one place.

[ Get Started ][55]
[ Watch Video ][56]
[ Get Started For Free ][57]
[HeroComp-updated]

### How it Works

#### Simplify your invoices & extend cash flow at same time

Your vendors get paid on time, the way they get paid today. You can leverage your existing cards,
short-term financing, or link your bank account to defer repayment to the last minute or your next
card statement

[person making cash payment icon]

###### Add your vendors.

Through integrations with accounting tools like QuickBooks Online, uploading your invoices,
utilizing Plastiq’s robust vendor network — tell us who you’d like to pay.

[Pay How You Like]

###### Pay how you want

Pay by credit card, bank account, or even get access to short-term financing — Plastiq gives you the
flexibility to use whatever payment method you prefer.

[Saving Wallet International by Streamlinehq]

###### Pay your vendor how they prefer.

Choose your vendor’s prefer delivery method and send your payment by paper check, ACH, or wire — you
can even send payments with same day delivery or internationally.

#### Same day delivery available

Plastiq can deliver your payment as fast as you need it. With optional same-day ACH transfers,
overnight checks, international and domestic wires sent same day — Plastiq has you covered.
[Delivery Methods]

#### Extend your cash flow

Plastiq makes sure that your vendors get paid on time — while you get the benefit of extended cash
flow. Use your card to extend repayment to your next billing cycle.
[Delivery Calendar]

#### Reconciliation made easy

Syncing directly to Quickbooks Online, Sage Intaact, Oracle Netsuite, and Xero — Plastiq will make
sure you don’t end up with duplicate entries or manual updates. You can keep your Bills, vendors,
and payments completely in sync.
[Reconcillation]

#### You’re always in control

With roles and approval permissions you can make sure that your approval practices are carried out
digitally. Always be in the know when it comes to your businesses finances.
[Persmissions]
[double check mark icon]

###### No subscription fees

Plastiq accounts and access to all of the amazing features is completely free. You only pay the fees
associated with sending payments.
[Learn more][58]
[monitor download icon]

###### Automated bill capture

You can email, sync, or upload bills to Plastiq and we will automatically scan and enter all of the
payment details for you.
[Learn more][59]
[international wallet icon]

###### International payments

Send payments to 45+ countries in 20+ currencies. Choose between same or next day transfers and get
sharable SWIFT and FedWire numbers to keep you in the know.
[Learn more][60]
[locked shield icon]

###### Keep your finances secure

Plastiq uses world class security practices and by sending checks through Plastiq you can make sure
your bank account information never makes it into the wrong hands.
[Learn more][61]
[track-funds-mobile]

###### Plastiq on the go

With the Plastiq mobile app available on both iOS and Google Play, you are never more than a tap
away from your financial pulse.   
[Learn more][62]
[certified-ribbon-rating-icon]

###### Earn rewards

End-to-end advisory services for corporations locating or optimizing office, R&D, and operations
space across Delhi. Services include site selection analysis, lease negotiation on a fee or contract
basis, portfolio optimization, and compliance review tailored to manufacturing corridors, logistics
hubs, and tech-enabled operations.

Specialized brokerage and contract management for industrial parks, warehouses, and logistics
facilities in major Delhi corridors. We provide feasibility assessments, infrastructure alignment
guidance, and structured fee-based transaction management to support manufacturing and supply-chain
scale-up.

Advisory and contracting solutions for flexible office and tech-enabled operations spaces, including
coworking strategy, captive campus leases, and fit-out liaison. Deliverables include market
benchmarking, service-level contract drafting, and staged occupancy planning to support technology
operations.

Documented negotiation strategy, clause-by-clause lease recommendations, financial pro-forma, and

* ### **Store**

  gives you full control over your balances with instant access whenever you need to move money.**

  streamlines every transfer with real-time tracking and fast settlement, so your recipients get
  paid without the wait.**

  **Accept payments from anywhere in the world with dedicated accounts. Mural Pay handles routing
  and FX complexity so funds land in your account ready to use. Seamlessly accept stablecoins now.**

  exactly what you're getting before you confirm, without hidden fees.**
* ### **Earn**

  cash into passive income.**
* ### **Comply**
  
  **Enable global financial workflows without having to acquire licensing or build your own
  compliance program. Mural Pay automates compliance checks and regulatory reporting so you can
  focus on growing your business.**

# Pay by credit card.
# Vendors get paid the way they want.

Plastiq gives you the flexibility to pay by credit card — even when your vendors don’t accept them.
Plastiq sends your payments to your vendor as a domestic or international wire,  same-day ACH
transfer, or overnight check — all in one place.

[ Get Started ][55]
[ Watch Video ][56]
[ Get Started For Free ][57]
[HeroComp-updated]

### How it Works

#### Simplify your invoices & extend cash flow at same time

Your vendors get paid on time, the way they get paid today. You can leverage your existing cards,
short-term financing, or link your bank account to defer repayment to the last minute or your next
card statement

[person making cash payment icon]

###### Add your vendors.

Through integrations with accounting tools like QuickBooks Online, uploading your invoices,
utilizing Plastiq’s robust vendor network — tell us who you’d like to pay.

[Pay How You Like]

###### Pay how you want

Pay by credit card, bank account, or even get access to short-term financing — Plastiq gives you the
flexibility to use whatever payment method you prefer.

[Saving Wallet International by Streamlinehq]

###### Pay your vendor how they prefer.

Choose your vendor’s prefer delivery method and send your payment by paper check, ACH, or wire — you
can even send payments with same day delivery or internationally.

#### Same day delivery available

Plastiq can deliver your payment as fast as you need it. With optional same-day ACH transfers,
overnight checks, international and domestic wires sent same day — Plastiq has you covered.
[Delivery Methods]

#### Extend your cash flow

Plastiq makes sure that your vendors get paid on time — while you get the benefit of extended cash
flow. Use your card to extend repayment to your next billing cycle.
[Delivery Calendar]

#### Reconciliation made easy

Syncing directly to Quickbooks Online, Sage Intaact, Oracle Netsuite, and Xero — Plastiq will make
sure you don’t end up with duplicate entries or manual updates. You can keep your Bills, vendors,
and payments completely in sync.
[Reconcillation]

#### You’re always in control

With roles and approval permissions you can make sure that your approval practices are carried out
digitally. Always be in the know when it comes to your businesses finances.
[Persmissions]
[double check mark icon]

###### No subscription fees

Plastiq accounts and access to all of the amazing features is completely free. You only pay the fees
associated with sending payments.
[Learn more][58]
[monitor download icon]

###### Automated bill capture

You can email, sync, or upload bills to Plastiq and we will automatically scan and enter all of the
payment details for you.
[Learn more][59]
[international wallet icon]

###### International payments

Send payments to 45+ countries in 20+ currencies. Choose between same or next day transfers and get
sharable SWIFT and FedWire numbers to keep you in the know.
[Learn more][60]
[locked shield icon]

###### Keep your finances secure

Plastiq uses world class security practices and by sending checks through Plastiq you can make sure
your bank account information never makes it into the wrong hands.
[Learn more][61]
[track-funds-mobile]

###### Plastiq on the go

With the Plastiq mobile app available on both iOS and Google Play, you are never more than a tap
away from your financial pulse.   
[Learn more][62]
[certified-ribbon-rating-icon]

###### Earn rewards
